title: Hearing the Order: Investigating Position Bias in Large Audio-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2510.00628v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) are often used in tasks that involve reasoning over ordered options. An open question is whether their predictions are influenced by the order of answer choices, which would indicate a form of position bias and undermine their reliability. In this paper, we identify and analyze this problem in LALMs. We demonstrate that no model is immune to this bias through extensive experiments on six LALMs across three widely used benchmarks and their spoken counterparts. Shuffling the order of answer options can cause performance fluctuations of up to 24% and even change model rankings, raising concerns about the reliability of current evaluation practices. We also study permutation-based strategies and show that they can mitigate bias in most cases. Our work represents the first systematic investigation of this issue in LALMs, and we hope it raises awareness and motivates further research in this direct

translated_title: 听见顺序：研究大型音频-语言模型中的位置偏见
translated_abstract: 大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）经常被用于涉及对有序选项进行推理的任务中。一个悬而未决的问题是，它们的预测是否会受到答案选项顺序的影响——如果会，这将表明存在一种位置偏见并损害其可靠性。在本文中，我们识别并分析了LALMs中的这一问题。通过对六个LALMs在三个广泛使用的基准测试及其口语对应版本上进行的大量实验，我们证明没有任何模型能够免受这种偏见的影响。打乱答案选项的顺序可能导致性能波动高达24%，甚至改变模型排名，这引发了对当前评估实践可靠性的担忧。我们还研究了基于排列的策略，并表明它们在大多数情况下可以缓解这种偏见。我们的工作是对LALMs中这一问题的首次系统性研究，我们希望它能够提高人们的认识并推动这一方向的进一步研究。
tldr: 本文首次系统性地研究了大型音频-语言模型中的位置偏见问题，通过对六个模型和三个基准测试的实验发现，打乱答案选项顺序可导致性能波动高达24%甚至改变模型排名，而基于排列的策略在多数情况下可缓解这一偏见。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic investigation of position bias in large audio-language models, showing that shuffling answer option order can cause performance fluctuations of up to 24% and even change model rankings across six models and three benchmarks, while permutation-based strategies can mitigate this bias in most cases.
